corridor: US-64; 54 miles to I-40 via TN-13 (MTIDA 2026).
top_park: Waynesboro Industrial Park on US-64 (1158 Tie Camp Rd), listed on TNECD's Opportunity Zones site; acreage not confirmed.
power: Tennessee Valley Electric Cooperative (city and county) (MTIDA 2026).
anchors: Largest employers overall: Wayne County Board of Education (~423), South Central Correctional Facility in Clifton (~230, CoreCivic), Wayne Halfway Home (~200), county government (~150) (TNECD county profile). Largest manufacturers: Hassell & Hughes Lumber (100), Independent Stave (58), Hughes Hardwood (43) (MTIDA, Jan. 2026).
challenges: Highest poverty rate (18.8%) and lowest median household income ($50,630) of the 13 counties (Census SAIPE 2024). Labor force participation 47.0% vs 62.4% statewide (Census ACS 2020-24). 54 miles to the nearest interstate (MTIDA).
workforce_signal: Manufacturing is 7.9% of private jobs, mostly wood products (BLS QCEW, Q1 2026; MTIDA). Unemployment 3.4% in Sep. 2026 (BLS).
